all.text: At this latitude, the Earth's spin carries the ship east at about 670 mph, whatever the captain is doing.
The sun reaches its highest point here about 5 minutes after it does in Southampton.
Drill straight through the Earth from here and you'd surface at 50.0°S, 177.3°E, about 680 km from Dunedin.
This far north, they're roughly level with Calgary, even though it's a world away.
The seabed is roughly 64 m below the ship.
